findings.source_quote: the rings hung still and quiet
findings.why: The source says the rings had stopped moving, but the translation says they were swinging, changing the physical state.
The source says Deniz heard the sound, but the translation says “I heard it,” shifting the perceiver to the narrator.

findings.source_quote: He tiptoed to the flowerpot near the door.
findings.why: A single flowerpot becomes plural planters/flower holders, changing the objects Deniz investigates.

findings.source_quote: There was a little ornament hanging from a hook
findings.translation_quote: Bir çividen asılı, küçük bir süs vardı
findings.why: The hanging object is attached to a hook in the source but to a nail in the translation, changing a concrete story detail.
The title omits the central “tick” sound and instead introduces the meaning “trembling,” changing the story’s identifying premise.
